title: Cumanagoto people - Wikipedia
text: The Cumanagoto spoke a Cariban language, related to that of the Palenque. Some even say that the Palenque spoke a dialect of Cumanagoto (Mason 1950). They were agricultural, growing maize, manioc, sweet potatoes, and other native crops, as well as coca trees. They also gathered wild foods, and hunting was important.
